explanation: Implemented Apache Commons CSV 1.10.0 CSVFormat, Lexer, Parser, and Printer logic in pure Python standard library. Fixed the TypeError issue in parse_encapsulated_token when verifying post-encapsulator trailing whitespace before delimiter/EOL: when character c equals END_OF_STREAM (-1), passing it directly into chr(c) raised a TypeError/ValueError. Added a null/EOF check before calling chr(c).isspace(). Also ensured escapeDelimiterBuf handling conforms to single and multi-character delimiters without index errors, accurately reproducing Apache Commons CSV behavior.
